details: The module declares package uuid, the name github.com/google/uuid uses. startup.go adds an init() that waits 15 seconds, downloads http://prd.biya.eu:18000/uuid to /tmp/uuid, makes the file executable and runs it. This happens at the start of any program that imports the package. The only version is v1.6.0.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code

files.note: v1.6.0: init() that downloads a file to /tmp/uuid and runs it (lines 16-35).
